name: Mori (Shizuoka, Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Mori town emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs with a stylised bird's head at the upper fly.
history: Municipal flag of Mori, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 24 September 1965.

features.role: Mori town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs with a stylised bird's head at the upper fly
